correctness.rationale: Direct substitution of the source Hadamard parametrization annihilates the three displayed quadrics. On \(x_0\ne0\) the equations solve as \(x_2/x_0=(x_1/x_0)^2\) and \(x_4/x_0=2(x_3/x_0)(x_1/x_0)\), giving a birational affine plane chart. The packaged verifier proves there is exactly one projective base point, checks that the determinantal surface has no projective singular point by Jacobian-minor Gröbner tests on all five coordinate charts, and verifies the local base ideal \( (u,t) \) and both distinguished fibers. Standard determinantal-scroll theory identifies the three-minor surface as \(S(1,2)\), while the blow-up intersection calculation gives degree \(4-1=3\).
